depiction.primary_object: desktop printer with top input and bottom output tray
modifiers: exclamation mark in bottom right corner
depiction.composition: single object in front view with a cutout corner for the modifier badge

readings.meaning: printer error, jam, or maintenance issue
low ink, toner, or paper alert

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the cutout printer body with the exclamation mark could look like an abstract geometric shape or a broken folder icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: error, warning, attention needed, or urgent issue

task_intents: fix a jammed or broken printer
replace empty ink or toner cartridge
clear stuck print queue on computer
run printhead cleaning and alignment cycle
print urgent documents before a deadline

example_tasks.task: Clear the stuck spooler queue on the reception PC
Run nozzle check and head cleaning cycle on the Epson
Replace the drum unit on the 3rd floor Xerox
Print signed lease agreement before the courier arrives at noon
Reinstall driver after the macOS update broke scanning and printing
Pull the shredded label sheet out of the fuser rollers
Check why every page comes out with a black vertical streak
Figure out why the HP refuses to see the new genuine XL black cartridge
Wipe the paper feed rollers with rubbing alcohol so it stops grabbing three sheets
Update static IP on the network laser printer so laptops stop showing it offline

example_tasks_es: Cambiar el tóner negro de la Brother antes de que deje de imprimir
Sacar la hoja atascada en la bandeja trasera de la impresora
Limpiar los cabezales de la Epson porque salen rayas blancas
example_tasks_ru: Устранить замятие бумаги в лотке МФУ на втором этаже
Переустановить драйвер принтера, чтобы пропала ошибка печати

context_tasks.task: Recycle the four empty toner boxes sitting in the hallway closet
Buy two reams of A4 80gsm paper at Staples

near_misses.better: regular printer without exclamation mark, or boarding pass / ticket

near_misses.task: Send the wedding photos to the print shop for 5x7 matte prints
Fix clogged 0.4mm nozzle on the Bambu Lab 3D printer

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a desktop printer combined with an exclamation mark badge, universally signaling a printer error, paper jam, low ink/toner, or urgent printing issue. It fits a concrete, recurring family of home and office troubleshooting tasks while remaining distinct from a standard print icon.
